name: climbing monkey bars
description: Swing from bar to bar along a horizontal ladder. It builds grip, shoulders and back with a playful challenge.
instructions: Grab the first bar with both hands and hang.
Swing your body slightly and reach for the next bar with one hand.
Release the back hand and reach for the following bar.
Keep a steady rhythm using your hips for momentum.
Continue to the end of the ladder.
Drop down softly and rest before the next pass.
